records.title: OmniDiagram: Advancing Unified Diagram Code Generation via Visual Interrogation Reward
records.reason: Primary paper addresses diagram-code generation using visual interrogation rewards; its domain method does not improve LLM inference runtime or resources.

records.title: Finding and Reactivating Post-Trained LLMs' Hidden Safety Mechanisms
records.reason: Primary paper identifies/reactivates post-trained safety mechanisms in LLMs; its target is safety capabilities, not inference efficiency.

records.title: SearchGym: Bootstrapping Real-World Search Agents via Cost-Effective and High-Fidelity Environment Simulation
records.reason: Primary text proposes a cost-effective simulated environment for training search agents; the cost reduction is in RL/environment interaction during training, not deployed LLM inference.

records.title: STEAD: Robust Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography with Diffusion Language Model
records.reason: Primary text develops a diffusion-language steganography method for secure message encoding; it is a language-model application and does not target inference systems.

records.title: Two Pathways to Truthfulness: On the Intrinsic Encoding of LLM Hallucinations
records.reason: Primary paper studies internal representations associated with hallucinations/truthfulness and analyzes their origin; it does not propose an inference-resource optimization.
